{{Quote|Ken's one of the brightest students at a very special school, Dagobah Tech. At the moment he's on vacation. Ken's classmates are the sons and daughters of the scientists who work at DRAPAC, our fortress, on Mount Yoda on the planet Dagobah.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>}}
'''Dagobah Tech''' was a school established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Defense Research and Planetary Assistance Center|DRAPAC]] facility on [[Mount Yoda]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The children of the military and civilian staff of the facility attended, along with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] informal [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], and [[Ken]].
